titles: Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace

list_child.name: list_modules
list_child.desc: Retrieve the full list of course modules currently assigned across every organization account on the platform. This includes modules in every state, from freshly assigned to expired.

get_child.name: get_module
get_child.desc: Look up a single course module using its unique identifier and return its complete assignment record. This is the primary way to inspect one module's due date and completion state.

list_parent.name: list_organizations
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the full list of organization accounts that have purchased seats on the platform. Every organization with an active or lapsed contract appears in this listing.

get_parent.name: get_organization
get_parent.desc: Look up a single organization account using its unique identifier. Returns the complete account record the platform keeps on file for that organization.

delete_child.name: delete_module
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase a course module assignment from the platform's records, an action that cannot be reversed once it completes. Use this only for assignments created in error or superseded by a corrected one.

set_enum.name: set_module_state
set_enum.desc: Update the state of a course module to reflect whether it is in progress, completed, or expired. Keeping this current matters for compliance reporting to each organization.

set_bool.name: flag_mandatory
set_bool.desc: Mark a course module as mandatory training so that completion is tracked against compliance requirements. This flag changes how the module appears in an organization's reporting dashboard.

set_ref.name: reassign_organization
set_ref.desc: Move a course module's assignment from one organization account to another, which is useful when a module was logged under the wrong contract. This change propagates immediately to both organizations' dashboards.

send.name: notify_organization
send.desc: Send a notification to an organization account regarding a course module or its overall training standing. This is the platform's primary channel for account-level communication.
